feature: Add file discard to review workflow
description: Add selective file discard functionality to the human review workflow, enabling users to exclude unwanted files (e.g., CSS changes) from task changes before merging/staging. This feature extends the existing DiffViewDialog with per-file discard actions that use git restore to revert specific files in the worktree without affecting other changes.

subtasks.description: Add discard button/action to each file entry in the diff view
subtasks.notes: Added discard button UI to DiffViewDialog. Implementation includes: optional onDiscardFile callback prop, Trash2 icon button with tooltip, ghost variant with destructive hover styling, stopPropagation for event handling. Button only renders when callback is provided.

subtasks.description: Add confirmation dialog for destructive discard action
subtasks.notes: Added confirmation dialog for destructive discard action. Implementation includes: useState hook to track file pending discard (fileToDiscard), separate AlertDialog for confirmation with destructive styling, file path display in confirmation dialog with clear warning message, AlertDialogAction with destructive variant styling, follows existing DiscardDialog pattern for consistency.

subtasks.description: Implement git restore command execution for selective file reversion
subtasks.notes: Implemented git restore command execution for selective file reversion. Added handleDiscardFile function in TaskDetailPanel.tsx that calls discardWorktreeFile API, wired up through TaskReview to DiffViewDialog. On success, refreshes diff view, worktree status, and merge preview. Error handling displays workspace error on failure.

subtasks.description: Add error handling and user feedback for restore operation
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive error handling and user feedback for restore operation. Implementation includes: (1) isDiscardingFile loading state, (2) discardFileSuccess state, (3) Loading spinners, (4) Error alert display, (5) Success message, (6) Auto-close dialog on success. TypeScript and ESLint checks pass.

subtasks.description: Update diff view state after file discard to reflect changes
subtasks.notes: Verified that diff view state update is already implemented in handleDiscardFile. After successful file discard: getWorktreeDiff refreshes file list, setWorktreeDiff updates state, getWorktreeStatus updates counts, loadMergePreview refreshes preview. TypeScript and ESLint checks pass.

subtasks.description: Test discard workflow with merge/stage/reject operations
subtasks.notes: Verified comprehensive test coverage for discard workflow with merge/stage/reject operations. Test file at apps/frontend/src/renderer/components/task-detail/__tests__/DiffViewDialog.test.tsx contains 34 tests covering: (1) File Discard UI - discard button visibility and click handling, (2) Confirmation Dialog - state management and confirmation flow, (3) Loading State - button disable and spinner during discard, (4) Error Handling - error display and dialog behavior, (5) Success Feedback - success message display and dialog close, (6) File List Updates - refresh after discard, (7) Pre-merge File Discard - allowing discard before merge, (8) Pre-stage File Discard - allowing discard before staging with preview refresh, (9) Reject with Partial Discard - combining discard with reject feedback, (10) State Consistency - clearing success messages, updating worktree status, refreshing merge preview, (11) Edge Cases - last file, renamed files, deleted files, concurrent operations, (12) Error Recovery - retry after failure, unaffected files. All 559 tests pass. TypeScript and ESLint checks pass.
